title: AIBU to want our wills to prioritise children over grandparents and siblings | Mumsnet

excerpts.text: My DH and I are writing our wills. We have a 3.5 year old and 1 year old and have decided that the best parental guardian for our children would be my mum. She already lives a 2 min walk away, has the kids a few times a week and is an excellent grandmother. My
Leaving to your siblings isn’t the done thing. Usually all assets are left equal between your kids. You are over complicating it.

It makes no sense to leave money to siblings when you have living children - they're the ones who are financially dependent on you. Re. who looks after the kids, can you name your in laws as substitute/backup guardians?
Have you actually asked his mum? Would you expect her to move into your home or have the children at hers? wills like insurance, you hope they won’t matter for another 50 years!

Not usual to leave money to siblings. Could you split the money 50:50 and he bequeaths a portion of his half to his siblings, and you bequeath some of your share to your sibling? or every sibling get 5% (?) which seem fairest if you want to give money to sibli
Oops your mum. Preffered sibling could be important to nominate

Have you spoke to both sets of grandparents? I think you need to ask someone before you put them in your will to look after your children and his parents might not want that responsibility anyway. Also yes I agree with you that you have to do what's best for t
Everything I own will go to my husband or children. Nothing to anyone else! I have put my sister as their carer if we die and with that comes reasonable expenses from our estate.
